headline: Your two OpenAI apps prove you can ship with a model. What is missing is evidence that you measured one.

gaps.name: LLM API integration
gaps.why: notes-ai and Recipe Genie call OpenAI, but both are small apps with one prompt each and no structured retries.

gaps.name: Prompt design
gaps.why: Recipe Genie's prompt takes dietary filters, and nothing shows a second version or why it changed.

gaps.name: RAG & retrieval
gaps.why: notes-ai has embeddings search, but its chunking and citations are still a TODO.

gaps.name: LLM evals
gaps.why: None of your 34 repos has an eval harness, and notes-ai has no tests, so nothing shows how an answer was judged.

gaps.name: AI UX patterns
gaps.why: Recipe Genie shows rotating loading text and a retry-less error toast: the states an AI product needs are not there yet.

evidence.text: Recipe Genie: OpenAI via Supabase Edge Function, structured JSON
Recipe Genie prompt takes dietary filters; no iteration shown
notes-ai: embeddings search, TODO lists chunking and citations
No eval harness in any of 34 repos; notes-ai has no tests
Recipe Genie has no output rating beyond a favourite heart
Only rotating loading text and a retry-less error toast
Rebuilt Kitebird checkout in React; owns 42-component Kite UI
3-week A/B test behind a feature flag on checkout

moves.title: Add an eval harness to notes-ai and publish its numbers
moves.body: Turn the app you already have into the one repo that shows retrieval, prompts and a judge working together.

have.text: notes-ai already calls OpenAI with embeddings search
Structured JSON from a Supabase Edge Function in Recipe Genie
motion-kit shows you write tests: 31 test files

phases.title: Finish retrieval
tasks: Implement the chunking and citations notes-ai lists as a TODO
Add a small labelled set of twenty questions with the right source for each
phases.deliverable: notes-ai answers with citations on a labelled set

phases.title: Build the judge
tasks: Write a judge prompt that scores an answer against its cited source
Keep two prompt versions and record which one the judge prefers
Add tests for the judge and the retrieval, in Vitest
phases.deliverable: A results table in the README, with the judge's scores per prompt version

phases.title: Make the model fail safely
tasks: Replace the retry-less error toast with a retry and a visible fallback
Stream the answer and show which sources were used while it writes
phases.deliverable: An app that shows its sources and recovers from a failed call

phases.title: Write it up
tasks: One post on how you judged the answers, with your numbers
Link the repo and the post from your resume and graph
phases.deliverable: A post, and a resume line that points to it

moves.title: Ship an eval-first feature in Recipe Genie
moves.body: Add one rated feature to the Lovable app you have users on, and measure it the way you measured checkout.

have.text: Recipe Genie runs OpenAI through a Supabase Edge Function
You ran a three-week A/B test behind a feature flag on checkout

phases.title: Rate the answers
tasks: Add thumbs up and down with a reason to every generated recipe
Log the prompt version with each rating
phases.deliverable: A ratings table you can query

phases.title: Change one thing
tasks: Write a second prompt version and split traffic behind a flag
Compare ratings per version after a week
phases.deliverable: A short comparison with real counts

phases.title: Show the states
tasks: Design the loading, partial and failed states of a generated recipe
Add a retry to the error toast
phases.deliverable: Three screens a reviewer can tap through

moves.title: Write up the two apps as one case study
moves.body: The smallest step: one honest page on what you built with OpenAI, what you did not measure, and what you would measure next.

have.text: Two shipped apps that call OpenAI

phases.title: Collect
tasks: List what each app does with the model and where it fails
Take screenshots of every AI state you have

phases.title: Draft
tasks: Write the problem, the approach and what was left out
Keep every number in brackets until you check it

phases.title: Publish
tasks: Post it on your portfolio site
Link it from your resume and graph
phases.deliverable: A case study you can point to
